svg.title: Тяга каната к лицу сидя — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED ROPE FACE PULL, three-quarter SIDE view. Both figures SIT on horizontal bench with hips on seat and feet on floor, facing a cable pulley tower located IN FRONT at FACE height. Cable ends in clearly split TWO-ENDED ROPE, one end each hand. Left: both arms reach forward nearly straight holding rope at shoulder height, cable taut. Right: pull rope ends apart TOWARD BOTH SIDES OF FACE/EARS, elbows flare out at shoulder height and bend; torso stays seated upright, no row to waist. Draw continuous cable from face-height pulley to rope knot and hands. Entire figure and bench visible. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
